think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and documented valid range/default. 2) Check whether any specific numeric value(s) (e.g., -1, 0) are documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (such as disabling a feature or changing semantics), rather than just being a smaller/larger quantity. 3) If such a mode-switching value exists, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
